summary: Tested multi-code referral support (RAJA05 5%/min-10, PRIMETIME31 10%/min-0) end-to-end. Backend: 14 pytest cases against /api/payments/order, /api/bookings, /api/admin/manual-booking + regressions on /api/payments/verify and /api/payments/webhook (13 passed pre-fix run, 2 real defects found). Frontend: full Playwright run of the referral card in BookingPanel (always-visible card, min-participant error, unknown-code error, apply/remove, 5% vs 10% dynamic label, downgrade warning). All requested frontend behaviours work, but the Pay Online button shows the UNDISCOUNTED amount. All 14 test bookings created were deleted via /api/admin/bookings/{ref} (verified 200/deleted).

critical.issue: Offline/manual payment path ignores referral_code entirely — it computes `total` inline instead of calling booking_total(). RAJA05 + 10 adults returned total=29990 (expected 28490/28491). referral_code IS stored on the doc, so an offline booking records the code but charges full price.

minor.issue: Half-paise rounding mismatch with the client: RAJA05 + 10 adults => base 29990, 5% off = 28490.5. Python round() (banker's rounding) returns 28490 while the frontend Math.round shows 28491. Razorpay order amount = 2849000 paise but the UI promised ₹28,491 (₹1 discrepancy). Same class of issue for any base ending in a .5 half-rupee. Suggest math.floor/Decimal-consistent rounding on both sides.

ui_bugs.issue: Button label uses `total` instead of `payableTotal` (line ~562). With PRIMETIME31 + 2 adults the summary shows ₹5,398 but the CTA reads 'PAY ONLINE ₹5,998'. Misleading price on the primary CTA (backend correctly charges the discounted amount).

issues: When the participant count drops below the code minimum, the applied chip still reads 'RAJA05 applied — you save ₹0' alongside the red warning. Contradictory messaging; chip should switch to a neutral/invalid style or auto-collapse to the input.

action_items: POST /api/bookings must use booking_total(input) (or resolve_referral) so offline bookings honour referral discounts.
Fix Pay Online button label to use payableTotal instead of total in BookingPanel.jsx.
Align rounding between backend (Python round) and frontend (Math.round) for half-rupee discounts, e.g. 10 adults + RAJA05.
Optional: clarify the applied-chip copy when the code becomes ineligible after guest-count reduction.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/bookings duplicates the price + doc-building logic that already exists in booking_total()/build_booking_doc() — DRY violation and the direct cause of the missing offline discount.
REFERRAL_CODES is duplicated in server.py and BookingPanel.jsx with no shared source; expose it via GET /api/event so the client can never drift from the backend rules.
server.py is 1511 lines — consider splitting routers (payments, admin, tickets) into modules.

Two tests are expected to fail until fixed: TestOfflineBooking::test_bookings_raja05_10_adults (offline path ignores discount) and TestOrderPricing::test_raja05_10_adults_half_paise_rounding (28490 vs 28491). Note /api/payments/order hits LIVE Razorpay to create orders — always clean up created references. Preview ingress needs a non-empty User-Agent header (UA dict in the test file).
rca_of_the_issue: booking_total() was updated to call resolve_referral(), and POST /api/payments/order + /api/admin/manual-booking use it. POST /api/bookings (offline path, server.py:524-529) has its own inline price computation that was never migrated to booking_total(), so referral codes are stored but never discounted. Separately, Python's round() uses banker's rounding while JS Math.round rounds .5 up, so any discounted total ending in .5 (e.g. 10 adults × 2999 × 0.95) differs by ₹1 between UI and the Razorpay order. The Pay Online CTA bug is a simple missed variable swap (total vs payableTotal) in BookingPanel.jsx.
